description.value:
Prerequisites: Dragoon 6

You may deliver all of your available attacks with a polearm or spear as a single, powerful thrust. Whenever you use a full-attack action to make multiple attacks with a polearm or spear that deals piercing damage against the same target, you total the damage from all your hits before applying that target's damage reduction. You suffer a -5 penalty to confirm critical hits during this period and a -2 penalty to your AC for 1 round after utilizing this talent.
